summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (mangled _0xNNNN identifiers, string-array dispatch pattern) and, when a local bun binary is not on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, chmods 0755, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle beginning '// @bun @bun-cjs' with a shuffled string array and rotating dispatcher; it is shipped only in the published tarball and does not exist in the package's src/ tree. The fetched alternate runtime is used to execute this opaque bundled artifact at npm install time under the installer's user privileges. The package is presented as a React chatbot API SDK, which has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an obfuscated bundle at install time; the runtime swap causes the payload to bypass Node-based registry and CI static analysis, and the src/publish divergence indicates the payload was injected outside the normal build path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
